name: Starstrike
description:
About This Game

Starstrike is an action packed space shooter. Take command of powerful ships and battle through sectors of space while you find new weapons and alien technologies. Improve your ship until you can take on entire fleets! Or die, upgrade, repeat.

Gameplay Features

  • Single-player roguelike action

  • Detailed ship damage. Every meter of a ship can be destroyed. Shoot off enemy weapons or engines to cripple them. Or overpower them with withering fire and watch their ship shatter.

  • Choose from multiple ships with different tactical loadouts and playstyles.

  • Advanced ship systems including teleporters, minelayers, and shield reflectors are available to bolster your offensive and defensive capabilities.
short_desc: Take command of Earth's most powerful starships and battle through the heart of enemy space in this action packed roguelike! Experience the thrill of full realtime destruction as you battle ever-increasing hordes of enemies.
